original-artwork-hamsa.title: ORIGINAL ARTWORK - HAMSA
original-artwork-hamsa.description:
Step into the realm of enchantment with my latest creation - an original painting featuring a magnificent blue owl in full flight, wings gracefully spread wide, adorned with captivating splashes of color. This painting isn't just powerful; it's a special masterpiece that brings incredible energies into any home.

Picture this captivating scene - the majestic owl, a symbol of wisdom and mystery, takes flight with wings that stretch across the canvas. The bursts of color add an extra layer of vibrancy, turning this artwork into a visual symphony.

More than a mere painting, this piece is a powerhouse of positive energy. Let the majestic presence of the blue owl fill your space with a sense of wonder and tranquility. It's not just art; it's an invitation to embrace the extraordinary in your everyday surroundings. Elevate your space with this powerful and special addition, and let its energies transform your home.

My original work of art, an original work is unique, yours, and only yours; there are no more!

The white canvas comes to me in the studio and on it I throw all the feelings, emotions and what is going on deep inside me.

Enjoy a piece that is part of my heart.

This canvas is shipped rolled and UNSTRETCHED.

You will need to have it stretched at a framer in your area before it will be ready to hang.

*SIGNATURE:
On the front side

The painting comes with a certificate of originality signed by Albert Levi .

 Dimensions:

150/100 centimeters . 
60/40 inches .

Shipping :Estimated shipping time 14-21 business days, depends on the location.

 

Please contact us if you have any problems with your order 

Please add your cell phone number for safe delivery

Thank you for your visiting and enjoy shopping.

Have a nice day (:

our-home.description:
Place your custom artwork, photos, or creative projects on a canvas you'll be proud to use. Each matte canvas comes with back hanging already included for convenient placement. The frame is made with profile radiata pine that is ethically sourced from renewable forests.

.: Materials: cotton and polyester composite (canvas), pine wood (frame)
.: Comes in 60 different sizes (including vertical and horizontal orientations)
.: Horizontal, vertical and square options available
.: Soft rubber dots on bottom back corners for support
.: Back hanging included
.: Inner frame made with radiata pine sourced from renewable forests
.: Please note: Due to the production process of the canvases, please allow for slight size deviations with a tolerance +/- 1/8" (3.2mm)

wings-of-freedom.title: Wings Of Freedom
wings-of-freedom.description:
Transform your space with this vibrant Matte Canvas wall art, featuring a stunning butterfly design that bursts with colors. This eye-catching piece embodies a sense of joy and creativity, perfect for those who appreciate the beauty of nature and artistic expression. Ideal for brightening up living rooms, bedrooms, or creative spaces, it adds a personal touch to your home decor. This canvas wall art is a great gift for art lovers, nature enthusiasts, or anyone looking to celebrate life's moments. It's perfect for occasions like housewarmings, birthdays, or as a unique holiday gift. Capture the essence of freedom and beauty with this striking artwork!

Product features
- Rubber dots on bottom to secure placement
- High-quality images with unique coating
- Sustainably sourced pine frame
- Non-toxic latex inks for safe display
- Available in 60 sizes and orientations

Care instructions
- If the canvas does gather any dust, you may wipe it off gently with a clean, damp cloth.

blue-dream-kitchen-apron.title: Blue Dream - Kitchen Apron
blue-dream-kitchen-apron.description:
This apron brings a quiet, starry wonder into the kitchen or studio. Deep, speckled navy frames a large, textured butterfly wing motif that feels like scattered moonlight on wet stone. The lightweight polyester holds the detailed print with clarity and dries quickly after spills. Black, detachable twill straps sit comfortably and adjust through buttonholes, so the apron moves with you as you cook, paint, or craft. It’s built to take daily use: overlocked seams and reinforced stitching keep the shape steady while the one-sided print lets the design sing without distraction. Slip it on to quietly transform routine moments—late-night baking, a weekend art project, or hosting friends—into something a little more magical.

Product features
- Durable 100% polyester fabric that retains shape and dries quickly
- Four buttonholes with black detachable twill straps for adjustable fit
- Overlocked seams and reinforced construction for long-lasting wear
- One-sided, high-detail print showcasing the starry butterfly wing design
- Pre-constructed sizing with slight variance; sourced blank from China

Care instructions
- Machine wash: cold (max 30C or 90F)
- Do not bleach
- Do not tumble dry
- Iron, steam or dry: low heat
- Do not dryclean

happinessa.description:
Place your custom artwork, photos, or creative projects on a canvas you'll be proud to use. Each matte canvas comes with back hanging already included for convenient placement. The frame is made with profile radiata pine that is ethically sourced from renewable forests.

.: Materials: cotton and polyester composite (canvas), pine wood (frame)
.: Comes in 48 different sizes (including vertical and horizontal orientations)
.: Horizontal, vertical and square options available
.: Soft rubber dots on bottom back corners for support
.: Back hanging included
.: Inner frame made with radiata pine sourced from renewable forests
.: Please note: Due to the production process of the canvases, please allow for slight size deviations with a tolerance +/- 1/8" (3.2mm)

am-yisrael-chai-earth-copy.description:
Transform your living space with our stunning Matte Canvas, Stretched artwork. This piece infuses any room with a warm, inviting vibe, perfect for adding a splash of creativity to your home or office. Ideal for art lovers and anyone looking to personalize their environment, this canvas is a wonderful addition to cozy corners or minimalist decor. Perfect for celebrating occasions like birthdays, housewarmings, or holidays, it makes for a thoughtful gift that resonates with compassion and inspiration.

Product features
- Rubber dots ensure stable hanging without slipping.
- Unique coating produces vibrant, high-quality images.
- Crafted from sustainable, FSC-certified pine wood.
- Printed using eco-friendly, non-toxic latex inks.
- Available in 60 different sizes and orientations.

Care instructions
- If the canvas does gather any dust, you may wipe it off gently with a clean, damp cloth.

tree-of-happiness-colorful-fruits.description:
The truth is, if you see me you will immediately understand why I created this piece.

It's funny to testify about myself, but I'm always smiling from ear to ear.

A smile is addictive, therefore, when the artwork is on your wall, you will have no choice but to go to sleep and wake up with a smile on your face and it will already make your day better, along with the combination of colors, you will definitely be happier.

A piece that fits any room you choose - living room, bedroom, dining room, foyer, office, etc.


Shipping and Packaging:

  • •• Ready to Hang Canvas •••

Your canvas will arrive Stretched on a hardwood back frame.

Ready for immediate display on your wall

Orders are shipped within 2 –5 business days.

Estimated shipping time 5-10 business days, depends on the location.



  • •rolled Canvas •••

Thank you for your visiting and enjoy shopping.

colors-of-protection.title: Colors of Protection
colors-of-protection.description:
Bring a splash of color and spirituality into your home with this stunning matte canvas print. Featuring a vibrant design that beautifully combines a hamsa hand and star motif, this artwork evokes a sense of positivity and protection. Perfect for adding a serene touch to any living space, it fits beautifully in meditation areas, bedrooms, or as a spirited focal point in your living room. This product is especially meaningful for those who value spiritual symbols and the vibrancy of color in their decor. Ideal for gifting during holidays like Hanukkah, or as a thoughtful housewarming present for friends and family who appreciate artistic expressions of faith and culture. Embrace the good vibes this canvas brings into your life!

Product features
- Rubber dots ensure the canvas stays securely in place.
- Unique coating enhances image quality using UL-certified inks.
- Made from sustainable, FSC-certified pine wood.
- Printed with non-hazardous, non-toxic latex inks.
- Available in various sizes and orientations.

Care instructions
- If the canvas does gather any dust, you may wipe it off gently with a clean, damp cloth.

tree-of-happiness-midnight-serenity-copy.title: Tree Of Happiness - Midnight Serenity
tree-of-happiness-midnight-serenity-copy.description:
"Midnight Serenity" invites you into a world of calmness with the captivating "Tree of Happiness" showcased on a striking black canvas, adorned in soothing shades of blue and white. The elegant interplay of blue and white hues creates a mesmerizing dance, infusing life and tranquility into your living space against the backdrop of the midnight sky.

Created with meticulous attention, the colors in this painting seamlessly blend artistry and a serene ambiance, offering a perfect balance that adds vibrancy and a soothing touch to your surroundings.

For those who appreciate the calming effects of color, "Midnight Serenity" stands as an ideal choice. Let it grace your home, infusing a sense of peace and celebrating the beauty of the "Tree of Happiness" against the dramatic canvas of midnight blacks.

Shipping and Packaging:

Ready to Hang Canvas: Your canvas will arrive stretched on a hardwood back frame, prepared for immediate display on your wall. Orders are shipped within 2–5 business days, with an estimated shipping time of 5-10 business days, depending on the location.

Rolled Canvas: Ideal if you plan to frame it yourself or at a local craft shop. Sides are 1.5”/4cm. Premium-grade 99% cotton 300g/m2 requires framing (frame not included). Estimated shipping time is 5-10 business days, depending on the location.

Please feel free to reach out if you encounter any issues with your order. For a smooth delivery process, kindly provide your cell phone number.

Thank you for visiting, and enjoy your shopping experience! Have a wonderful day. (:

original-artwork.title: ORIGINAL ARTWORK - home Of The Heart
original-artwork.description:
Step into the realm of enchantment with my latest creation - an original painting featuring a magnificent blue owl in full flight, wings gracefully spread wide, adorned with captivating splashes of color. This painting isn't just powerful; it's a special masterpiece that brings incredible energies into any home.

Picture this captivating scene - the majestic owl, a symbol of wisdom and mystery, takes flight with wings that stretch across the canvas. The bursts of color add an extra layer of vibrancy, turning this artwork into a visual symphony.

More than a mere painting, this piece is a powerhouse of positive energy. Let the majestic presence of the blue owl fill your space with a sense of wonder and tranquility. It's not just art; it's an invitation to embrace the extraordinary in your everyday surroundings. Elevate your space with this powerful and special addition, and let its energies transform your home.

My original work of art, an original work is unique, yours, and only yours; there are no more!

The white canvas comes to me in the studio and on it I throw all the feelings, emotions and what is going on deep inside me.

Enjoy a piece that is part of my heart.

This canvas is shipped rolled and UNSTRETCHED.

You will need to have it stretched at a framer in your area before it will be ready to hang.

*SIGNATURE:
On the front side

The painting comes with a certificate of originality signed by Albert Levi .

 Dimensions:

150/100 centimeters . 
60/40 inches .

Shipping :Estimated shipping time 14-21 business days, depends on the location.

 

Please contact us if you have any problems with your order 

Please add your cell phone number for safe delivery

Thank you for your visiting and enjoy shopping.

Have a nice day (:

after-nova-smile-forever.description:
Feel the infectious joy and energy of "smile forever" This captivating canvas print features a colorful women's portrait that exudes warmth and happiness.

Created with the expressive knife technique and acrylic, this artwork showcases a woman with a big, inviting smile, long flowing hair, and playful splashes of vibrant color.

The use of the knife technique brings texture and depth to the portrait, enhancing the sense of movement and vivacity. It's a tribute to the beauty of individuality, positivity, and the sheer delight of life itself.

"smile forever" is more than just a painting; it's a daily reminder to embrace life with a smile and to celebrate your unique spirit.

Hang it in your home or workspace to infuse a touch of happiness and positivity into your surroundings. This piece is perfect for those who appreciate the radiance of the human spirit and the power of a joyful disposition.

limited-edition-print-we-will-dance-agai.title: Embellished Edition Print - Strong Together
limited-edition-print-we-will-dance-agai.description:
Behold the "blue and white intensity" a captivating canvas print that beckons you into the mesmerizing world of the wild. This extraordinary artwork features a striking lion's face set against a deep black background. What makes this piece truly exceptional is the way the lion's visage is divided in half, with one side bathed in regal blue tones and the other side in serene white.

The mane, a work of art in itself, is rendered through skillful splashes of vibrant color, adding an extra layer of dynamism to the composition. The lion's piercing gaze draws you in and evokes a sense of awe and majesty.

"blue and white intensity," isn't just a painting; it's an homage to the magnificence of the animal kingdom and the power of nature's beauty. Hang it in your space, and let it remind you of the strength and grace of these regal creatures. This piece is perfect for those who appreciate the untamed spirit of the wild.

limited-edition-print-wing-of-freedom.description:
Behold the "blue and white intensity" a captivating canvas print that beckons you into the mesmerizing world of the wild. This extraordinary artwork features a striking lion's face set against a deep black background. What makes this piece truly exceptional is the way the lion's visage is divided in half, with one side bathed in regal blue tones and the other side in serene white.

The mane, a work of art in itself, is rendered through skillful splashes of vibrant color, adding an extra layer of dynamism to the composition. The lion's piercing gaze draws you in and evokes a sense of awe and majesty.

"blue and white intensity," isn't just a painting; it's an homage to the magnificence of the animal kingdom and the power of nature's beauty. Hang it in your space, and let it remind you of the strength and grace of these regal creatures. This piece is perfect for those who appreciate the untamed spirit of the wild.

limited-edition-print-the-magic-of-color.title: Embellished Edition Print - The Magic Of Color
limited-edition-print-the-magic-of-color.description:
Behold the "blue and white intensity" a captivating canvas print that beckons you into the mesmerizing world of the wild. This extraordinary artwork features a striking lion's face set against a deep black background. What makes this piece truly exceptional is the way the lion's visage is divided in half, with one side bathed in regal blue tones and the other side in serene white.

The mane, a work of art in itself, is rendered through skillful splashes of vibrant color, adding an extra layer of dynamism to the composition. The lion's piercing gaze draws you in and evokes a sense of awe and majesty.

"blue and white intensity," isn't just a painting; it's an homage to the magnificence of the animal kingdom and the power of nature's beauty. Hang it in your space, and let it remind you of the strength and grace of these regal creatures. This piece is perfect for those who appreciate the untamed spirit of the wild.

limited-edition-print-me.title: Embellished Edition Print - Me
limited-edition-print-me.description:
Life is not black and white, it’s a rainbow of colors. That’s the message of Circle of Life, the abstract painting that reflects the artist’s personal meaning. This striking painting features a colorful circle that moves freely between a black-and-white diagonal background.

The circle is made up of splattered paint in shades of pink, blue, green, and yellow. It represents the diversity and complexity of life, while the background represents the extremes and contrasts that we face. The circle dominates the canvas and attracts the eye more, showing that life is full of possibilities and choices. It’s a piece that fits any room you choose - living room, bedroom, dining room, foyer, office, etc. Circle of Life is more than just a painting, it’s a philosophy. It’s the perfect abstract painting for anyone who wants to discover the spectrum of life with Circle of Life

limited-edition-print-magic-in-nature.title: Embellished Edition Print - Magic in Nature
limited-edition-print-magic-in-nature.description:
Life is not black and white, it’s a rainbow of colors. That’s the message of Circle of Life, the abstract painting that reflects the artist’s personal meaning. This striking painting features a colorful circle that moves freely between a black-and-white diagonal background.

The circle is made up of splattered paint in shades of pink, blue, green, and yellow. It represents the diversity and complexity of life, while the background represents the extremes and contrasts that we face. The circle dominates the canvas and attracts the eye more, showing that life is full of possibilities and choices. It’s a piece that fits any room you choose - living room, bedroom, dining room, foyer, office, etc. Circle of Life is more than just a painting, it’s a philosophy. It’s the perfect abstract painting for anyone who wants to discover the spectrum of life with Circle of Life

It’s a piece that fits any room you choose - living room, bedroom, dining room, foyer, office, etc. Circle of Life is more than just a painting, it’s a philosophy. It’s the perfect abstract painting for anyone who wants to discover the spectrum of life with Circle of Life

hard-life-good-life.title: Hard life, good life
hard-life-good-life.description:
Immerse yourself in the captivating world of color and expression with "Hard life, good life" This stunning canvas print showcases a woman's face in a burst of vivid and lively tones, brought to life with the dynamic knife technique and acrylic paints.

Her short, bold hair and the playful splashes of color make this artwork truly stand out. Each stroke of the knife technique adds depth and texture to the portrait, creating a unique visual experience. This piece is a celebration of individuality and self-expression, a powerful reminder that beauty comes in many forms and shades.

"Hard life, good life" is more than just a painting; it's a testament to the diverse and colorful nature of humanity. Hang it in your living space, and let it be a daily inspiration to embrace your uniqueness and express yourself with confidence. This piece is perfect for those who appreciate the vibrant tapestry of life and the beauty of self-discovery.

This stunning painting is a masterpiece of color and texture, depicting a calm sunset over the ocean with three sailboats on the horizon. It brings a lot of light into your house and opens up the space laterally. It is a piece that fits any room you choose - living room, bedroom, dining room, foyer, office, etc. Calm Sunset is more than just a painting, it’s a mood. bursting-power.title: Bursting Power
bursting-power.description:
"bursting power" is a canvas print that's both whimsical and artistic. It showcases a drawing of a man in a stylish suit, but with a fun twist – his head is actually the head of an elephant! This unique blend of human and animal imagery is a conversation starter.

The elephant, with its raised trunk, adds an element of playfulness to the scene as it blows out bursts of colorful, lively splashes.

This artwork is all about mixing sophistication with a touch of imagination. It's perfect for those who appreciate a dash of creativity in their decor and enjoy art that sparks conversations. Hang it up to add a dose of charm and personality to your space.


Shipping and Packaging:

infinite-sky.title: Infinite Sky
infinite-sky.description:
Elevate your space with this stunning matte canvas artwork, designed to inspire and evoke a sense of eternity. With its mesmerizing infinity symbol crafted in vibrant blues, this piece effortlessly adds a touch of elegance to any room. Ideal for art lovers, spiritual seekers, or anyone who appreciates modern aesthetics, it's a perfect addition to your home decor or office space. This canvas fits beautifully in a variety of settings, from living rooms to meditation areas, making it a versatile choice for your decor needs. Celebrate special occasions such as housewarmings, birthdays, or anniversaries by gifting this unique piece. Its calming palette and contemporary design create a peaceful atmosphere, making it suitable for those seeking tranquility and beauty in their surroundings.

Product features
- 2 rubber dots on the bottom ensure stability when hung.
- Unique coating for high-quality images using Greenguard Gold inks.
- Sustainable materials sourced from FSC certified renewable forests.
- Non-toxic latex inks ensure safety and eco-friendliness.
- Available in various sizes and orientations to fit any space.

Care instructions
- If the canvas does gather any dust, you may wipe it off gently with a clean, damp cloth.

light-of-hope.title: Light of Hope
light-of-hope.description:
Elevate your home decor with this stunning canvas print, a perfect blend of art and emotion. The vibrant colors and intricate design create an inviting atmosphere, making it a wonderful focal point in any room. This canvas not only brings beauty but also warmth to your space, making it ideal for cozy living rooms or serene bedrooms. Perfect for art enthusiasts and those looking to celebrate their heritage or spirituality, this piece resonates during holidays like Hanukkah and cultural observances. It serves as a thoughtful gift for family, friends, or anyone wanting to enrich their surroundings with meaningful art.

Product features
- Rubber dots ensure stable hanging without slips.
- Unique coating for vibrant, high-quality images.
- Made from sustainable materials sourced from renewable forests.
- Printed with non-toxic, safe latex inks.
- Available in multiple sizes and orientations for any space.

Care instructions
- If the canvas does gather any dust, you may wipe it off gently with a clean, damp cloth.

a-moment-of-silence.title: A moment of silence
a-moment-of-silence.description:
i have a busy and stressful life, but i also have a secret escape. Every morning, i go to the sea and do a workout. It’s my golden moment, my place to think, my moment of silence. i feel calm, strong, energetic, and creative.

with A Moment of Silence, the abstract painting that captures the essence of your morning ritual. This beautiful painting shows a serene seascape in shades of blue and white. You can almost hear the waves and feel the breeze. It’s a piece that fits any room you choose - living room, bedroom, dining room, foyer, office, etc. A Moment of Silence is more than just a painting, it’s a reminder. It reminds you to take a break, breathe deeply, and find your zen with A Moment of Silence.

am-yisrael-chai-earth.description:
Transform your living space with our stunning Matte Canvas, Stretched artwork. This piece infuses any room with a warm, inviting vibe, perfect for adding a splash of creativity to your home or office. Ideal for art lovers and anyone looking to personalize their environment, this canvas is a wonderful addition to cozy corners or minimalist decor. Perfect for celebrating occasions like birthdays, housewarmings, or holidays, it makes for a thoughtful gift that resonates with compassion and inspiration.

Product features
- Rubber dots ensure stable hanging without slipping.
- Unique coating produces vibrant, high-quality images.
- Crafted from sustainable, FSC-certified pine wood.
- Printed using eco-friendly, non-toxic latex inks.
- Available in 60 different sizes and orientations.

Care instructions
- If the canvas does gather any dust, you may wipe it off gently with a clean, damp cloth.

circle-of-life.title: CIRCLE OF LIFE
circle-of-life.description:
Life is not black and white, it’s a rainbow of colors. That’s the message of Circle of Life, the abstract painting that reflects the artist’s personal meaning. This striking painting features a colorful circle that moves freely between a black-and-white diagonal background.

The circle is made up of splattered paint in shades of pink, blue, green, and yellow. It represents the diversity and complexity of life, while the background represents the extremes and contrasts that we face. The circle dominates the canvas and attracts the eye more, showing that life is full of possibilities and choices. It’s a piece that fits any room you choose - living room, bedroom, dining room, foyer, office, etc. Circle of Life is more than just a painting, it’s a philosophy. It’s the perfect abstract painting for anyone who wants to discover the spectrum of life with Circle of Life

exact-geometry-precise-colorful-refined-.title: EXACT GEOMETRY - PRECISE, COLORFUL, REFINED DESIGN
exact-geometry-precise-colorful-refined-.description:
Behold a work of art that transcends the bounds of artistic expression and creative space. From its precise, geometric shapes to its vibrant hues, Exact Geometry captivates the eye and captures the imagination.

As you peruse its vibrant colors and sharply contrasting lines, a sense of balance and equilibrium is struck between chaos and order, providing a stimulating sight that delights the senses.

This remarkable piece is more than just an aesthetically pleasurable item - it's designed to seamlessly fit any space. Whether it be in a living area, bedroom, dining room, foyer, office or otherwise, Exact Geometry finds harmony and beauty wherever it's placed. Let Exact Geometry captivate you with its precise yet colorful composition. Open the door to a stimulating new aesthetic, infused with energy and passion.

Find equilibrium and harmony - and something truly special.

family-stride.title: Family Stride
family-stride.description:
"Family Stride" is a canvas print that speaks to the beauty of togetherness. In this artwork, a family of five majestic elephants walks forward as one. They are painted in powerful and striking shades of green, symbolizing strength and unity. Against a gentle, light gray background, the sense of family and harmony shines through.

This painting captures the essence of a loving, strong family, making it a wonderful addition to any home. It's a beautiful reminder of the bonds that tie us together and the power of unity.

"Family Stride" is perfect for those who value the importance of family and the elegance of nature's creatures. Hang it up to bring a touch of family warmth and natural beauty into your living space.

flowers-in-the-hair.title: Flowers In The Hair
flowers-in-the-hair.description:
Transform your space with this stunning Matte Canvas. Featuring an eye-catching artwork that portrays an essence of nature and beauty, this canvas print brings a breath of fresh air to any room. The vibrant colors and unique design create a serene atmosphere, making it perfect for living rooms, bedrooms, or creative spaces. Ideal for art enthusiasts and those looking to elevate their home decor, this canvas serves as a captivating focal point. Celebrate love, friendship, and creativity with this piece during occasions like housewarmings, birthdays, or any special gathering. Its versatility ensures it complements various styles, from bohemian to contemporary. Let this canvas inspire and brighten your daily life!

Product features
- 2 rubber dots on the bottom keep the canvas in place when hung
- Unique coating provides high-quality images using Greenguard Gold inks
- Sustainably sourced pine frame from FSC certified forests
- Printed with non-toxic, non-flammable latex inks
- Available in 60 different sizes, including multiple orientations

Care instructions
- If the canvas does gather any dust, you may wipe it off gently with a clean, damp cloth.

funky-frog-in-square-shades.description:
"Funky Frog in Square Shades" is a canvas print that's all about cool, quirky style. This groovy frog dons a pair of slick shades and is created using an array of squares in black and white and gray tones. But what truly makes this artwork stand out is the extraordinary background – a special, vibrant canvas dripping with paint that shines and exudes a mechanical, almost futuristic vibe.

The combination of the frog's playful charisma and the unique, shiny, and colorful background is a true showstopper. This piece is perfect for those who love to infuse their space with personality and an artistic, one-of-a-kind touch. Hang it up to bring a burst of color and creativity into your home.

elegance-in-motion.title: Elegance in Motion
elegance-in-motion.description:
Experience the timeless grace and artistry of "Elegance in Motion."

This mesmerizing canvas print captures the essence of a ballerina in a delicate dance position. The ballerina's body is depicted in striking black and white tones, while her ethereal dress shimmers with soft and enchanting shades of pink, all created using a symphony of color splashes on the canvas.

This masterpiece is a testament to the beauty of ballet and the transcendent art of dance. The contrast between the monochrome and the subtle hints of pink evokes a sense of elegance and movement. Every splash of color seems to echo the ballerina's delicate steps.

"Elegance in Motion" isn't just a painting; it's an ode to the beauty of dance and the sheer poetry of motion. Hang it in your living space, and let it inspire a sense of grace and artistry in your daily life. This piece is perfect for those who appreciate the timeless allure of ballet and the art of dance.

 

Of my special and magical creations, the feeling of peace you get from looking at a work on the wall is indescribable in words.


She is so interesting and intriguing, using my special technique I created her pink skirt.


Unparalleled, brings light and positive energies into every space.


A piece that fits any room you choose - living room, bedroom, dining room, foyer, office, etc.

dancing-with-color.title: Dancing with Color
dancing-with-color.description:
Dancing with Color is a canvas print that captures the grace and artistry of a dancer performing on a pole. The dancer's figure is portrayed in classic black and white, emphasizing the beauty of their movements. What makes this artwork exceptional is the way it combines these monochrome tones with bursts of vibrant colors in the background.

These splashes of color add an exciting dynamic to the piece, making it a visual celebration of dance and self-expression. "Dance with color" is a great addition to any space, perfect for those who appreciate the elegance of dance and the power of artistic movement.

Hang it up and infuse your surroundings with the energy and creativity of dance.

strong-family.description:

Crafted using the exquisite technique of knives and acrylic paints, this masterpiece showcases a family of four elephants in serene, greenish tones.

Against a rich black background, these majestic creatures come to life, capturing the essence of familial love and unity. The contrast between the vivid greens and the deep black provides a stunning visual impact that's sure to inspire awe.

"strong Family" goes beyond being a work of art; it's a testament to the enduring strength of family bonds. Hang it in your home, and let it serve as a daily reminder of the importance of unity and love. This piece is perfect for those who appreciate the majesty of nature and the significance of family ties.

harmony-of-koi.title: Harmony of Koi
harmony-of-koi.description:
"Harmony of Koi" is a canvas print that captures the balance and beauty of yin and yang in the form of koi fish. One fish is painted in serene white, and the other in deep black, symbolizing the harmonious interplay of opposites.

The blue background resembles a tranquil lake, where the koi swim together in perfect unity. It's a representation of balance and the peaceful coexistence of contrasting elements in nature.

"Harmony of Koi" is perfect for those who appreciate the concept of harmony and the symbolism of yin and yang. Display it in your space to bring a sense of peace and balance into your surroundings, reminding you of the beauty of equilibrium.

Shipping and Packaging:

  • •• Ready to Hang Canvas •••

Your canvas will arrive Stretched on a hardwood back frame.

Ready for immediate display on your wall

Orders are shipped within 2 –5 business days.

Estimated shipping time 5-10 business days, depends on the location.



  • •rolled Canvas •••

Is a great starter option if you plan to frame it by yourself/local craft shop

Fits for Thin and Gallery canvas frame, sides are 1.5”/4cm

Premium-grade 99% cotton 300g/m2 Requests framing (frame is not included with this option)

Estimated shipping time 5-10 business days, depends on the location.


Please contact us if you have any problems with your order 

Please add your cell phone number for safe delivery

Thank you for your visiting and enjoy shopping.

Have a nice day (:

harmony-wings.title: Harmony Wings
harmony-wings.description: "Harmony Wings" is a testament to the delicate balance of opposites, a butterfly poised on the edge between light and dark. This captivating painting features a vibrant and intricate butterfly, its wings painted in a symphony of colors, gracefully suspended against a canvas divided into half black and half white.<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">The contrasting background symbolizes the duality of life—the yin and yang, the balance between shadows and light. The butterfly, a symbol of transformation and beauty, dances on this delicate boundary, reminding us that true harmony emerges from the interplay of opposing forces.<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">As the butterfly gracefully flutters between the realms of black and white, it carries a profound message of finding balance and embracing both the shadows and the light. "Harmony Wings" encourages us to appreciate the beauty in contrasts, to navigate life's complexities with grace, and to discover the exquisite harmony that arises when opposites coexist.<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">**Shipping and Packaging:**<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">**Ready to Hang Canvas:**<br data-mce-fragment="1">Your canvas will arrive stretched on a hardwood back frame, prepared for immediate display on your wall. Orders are shipped within 2–5 business days, with an estimated shipping time of 5-10 business days, depending on the location.<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">**Rolled Canvas:**<br data-mce-fragment="1">Ideal if you plan to frame it yourself or at a local craft shop. Sides are 1.5”/4cm. Premium-grade 99% cotton 300g/m2 requires framing (frame not included). Estimated shipping time is 5-10 business days, depending on the location.<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">Please feel free to reach out if you encounter any issues with your order. For a smooth delivery process, kindly provide your cell phone number.<br data-mce-fragment="1"><br data-mce-fragment="1">Thank you for visiting, and enjoy your shopping experience! Have a wonderful day. (:

tree-of-happines-pink-magic.title: Tree of Happiness, Pink Magic
tree-of-happines-pink-magic.description:
"Pink Magic" is a canvas print that breathes life into the "Tree of Happiness" with a distinctive touch. This unique artwork features the tree painted in special and glowing shades of pink, set against a deep black background. The result is a painting that infuses your home with an explosion of color and energy.

"Pink Magic" is a perfect choice for those who appreciate the vibrant and joyful aspects of art. Hang it up to bring a touch of happiness and a burst of color into your living space, celebrating the unique charm of this artwork.

Shipping and Packaging:

my-head-exploded.title: MY HEAD EXPLODED
my-head-exploded.description:
Do you ever feel like your head is about to explode with ideas, emotions, and dreams? Do you want to express yourself in a bold and original way? Then you need My Head Exploded, the abstract art piece that captures the essence of your inner world.

This stunning piece features a figure with an exploding head, surrounded by a swirl of black and white shapes and a splash of vibrant colors. The contrast between the monochrome and the colorful elements creates a dynamic and dramatic effect, while the explosion symbolizes the release of your creative potential.

My Head Exploded is more than just a painting, it’s a statement. It shows that you are not afraid to embrace the chaos and unleash your creativity. It’s the perfect abstract art piece for anyone who wants to add some spice and personality to their space .


Shipping and Packaging:

  • •• Ready to Hang canvas •••

Your canvas will arrive Stretched on a hardwood back frame.

Ready for immediate display on your wall

Orders are shipped within 2 –5 business days.

Premium-grade 99% cotton 300g/m2 Requests framing (frame is not included with this option)

Estimated shipping time 5-10 business days, depends on the location.

tree-of-happiness-earth.title: Tree Of Happiness- Earth
tree-of-happiness-earth.description:
"Earthy Elegance" beckons you into a realm of tranquility with the captivating "Tree of Happiness" showcased on a pristine white canvas, adorned in warm and earthy brown tones. The gentle fusion of brown and white hues creates a harmonious dance, infusing life and rich color into your living space.

Crafted with meticulous care, the colors in this painting seamlessly blend artistry and a sense of grounded elegance, offering a perfect balance that adds vibrancy and a soothing touch to your surroundings.

For those who cherish the calming effects of color, "Earthy Elegance" stands as an ideal choice. Let it grace your home, infusing a sense of peace and celebrating the beauty of the "Tree of Happiness" in rich, earthy browns.

Shipping and Packaging:

Ready to Hang Canvas: Your canvas will arrive stretched on a hardwood back frame, prepared for immediate display on your wall. Orders are shipped within 2–5 business days, with an estimated shipping time of 5-10 business days, depending on the location.

Rolled Canvas: Ideal if you plan to frame it yourself or at a local craft shop. Sides are 1.5”/4cm. Premium-grade 99% cotton 300g/m2 requires framing (frame not included). Estimated shipping time is 5-10 business days, depending on the location.

Please feel free to reach out if you encounter any issues with your order. For a smooth delivery process, kindly provide your cell phone number.

Thank you for visiting, and enjoy your shopping experience! Have a wonderful day. (:

power-in-aviation.title: POWER IN AVIATION
power-in-aviation.description:
"Power in Aviation" is a canvas print that's not just art; it's a piece of my own artistic journey. In this creation, I've captured the enchanting flight of an owl in mid-air, with outstretched wings and a majestic presence. The owl is bathed in a special shade of blue, and its wings are brought to life through a unique color splash technique on the canvas.

This artwork is a personal statement, a reflection of my love for nature's wonders and my dedication to my craft. The owl's flight represents the freedom of expression, and the striking blue hue adds an extra layer of depth and meaning.

"Power in Aviation" is perfect for anyone who appreciates the art of storytelling through visuals and the power of creativity. Display it with pride in your space, and let it inspire a sense of wonder and the magic of artistic expression.

powerful-dance.title: Powerful Dance
powerful-dance.description:
Dive into the world of elegance and precision with "Powerful dance" a captivating canvas print that focuses on the exquisite art of ballet. This masterpiece showcases a detailed drawing of a ballet dancer's feet, with graceful ballet shoes in enchanting shades of pink. What makes this artwork truly unique is the use of an acrylic application technique with knives to bring the shoes to life.

The ballet shoes, seemingly frozen in mid-dance, release a cascade of colorful splashes in all directions, adding a sense of dynamic motion and artistic energy to the piece. Powerful dance captures the essence of the dancer's strength and the beauty of their performance.

This artwork isn't just a painting; it's a celebration of the dedication and artistry of ballet dancers. Display it in your home to honor the world of dance and the dedication it takes to achieve such grace.

"Powerful dance" is perfect for those who appreciate the delicate art of ballet and the magic of a dancer's feet.

tree-of-life-turquoise-tranquility.title: TREE OF LIFE - Turquoise Tranquility
tree-of-life-turquoise-tranquility.description:
"Turquoise Tranquility" invites you into a world of calmness with the captivating "Tree of Happiness" showcased on a pristine white canvas, adorned in tranquil shades of turquoise. The serene hues of turquoise and white intertwine, creating a harmonious dance that breathes life and color into your home.

Meticulously crafted, the colors in this painting blend artistry and tranquility, offering a perfect balance that adds vibrancy and a soothing touch to your living space.

For those who appreciate the calming effects of color, "Turquoise Tranquility" is an ideal choice. Display it to infuse your home with a sense of peace, celebrating the beauty of the "Tree of Happiness."

Shipping and Packaging:

Ready to Hang Canvas: Your canvas will arrive stretched on a hardwood back frame, ready for immediate display on your wall. Orders are shipped within 2–5 business days, with an estimated shipping time of 5-10 business days, depending on the location.

Rolled Canvas: A great option if you plan to frame it yourself or at a local craft shop. Sides are 1.5”/4cm. Premium-grade 99% cotton 300g/m2 requires framing (frame not included). Estimated shipping time is 5-10 business days, depending on the location.

Please don't hesitate to contact us if you encounter any issues with your order. For a smooth delivery process, kindly provide your cell phone number.

Thank you for visiting, and happy shopping! Have a wonderful day. (:

roar-of-strength.title: Roar of Strength
roar-of-strength.description:
"Roar of Strength" is a canvas print that embodies the majestic power of a lion on the march. In this remarkable artwork, I've captured the lion mid-roar, and from its mouth erupts a cascade of paint, created using a special technique of splashing vibrant colors on the canvas.

This lion, painted in striking shades of blue, stands out against a unique gray background, symbolizing both strength and ferocity. It's a one-of-a-kind painting that exudes an undeniable sense of power and allure.

"Roar of Strength" is perfect for those who admire the magnificence of the animal kingdom and appreciate the creative fusion of art and nature. Display it with pride, and let it infuse your space with the raw energy and the unique artistic spirit captured in this extraordinary piece.

With a unique style characterized by bold colors and intricate details, my paintings come to life on the canvas, evoking emotions and telling stories. Inspired by the beauty of nature, diverse cultures, and the interplay of light and shadow, each piece is infused with my distinctive artistic vision. Through my art, I aim to bring joy, inspiration, and a touch of whimsy into the lives of art enthusiasts and collectors alike.

tree-of-life-natural.title: Tree Of Life Natural
tree-of-life-natural.description:
Enhance your space with this stunning canvas print, perfect for bringing warmth and inspiration into any room. The vivid imagery of nature's beauty captures attention and invites a feeling of tranquility. Whether placed in a living room, office, or bedroom, this canvas serves as a daily reminder of growth and renewal. Ideal for art lovers, nature enthusiasts, and anyone looking to elevate their home decor. This piece makes a thoughtful gift for housewarmings, holidays, or special celebrations like Earth Day, enhancing any environment with its artistic charm.

Product features
- Rubber dots ensure stability when hung on the wall.
- Printed with UL-certified Greenguard Gold inks for vibrant, high-quality images.
- Made from sustainably sourced pine wood from renewable forests.
- Crafted using non-toxic and non-hazardous latex inks for a safe home environment.
- Available in 60 sizes and orientations to perfectly fit your space.

Care instructions
- If the canvas does gather any dust, you may wipe it off gently with a clean, damp cloth.

wild-majestiy.description:

This powerful artwork is perfect for anyone who appreciates the grandeur of nature's most majestic beasts. Hang it up to bring a sense of strength and sophistication into your space and celebrate the lion's elegance and authority.

map-of-israel-never-again.title: Map Of Israel - Never Again
map-of-israel-never-again.description:
Place your custom artwork, photos, or creative projects on a canvas you'll be proud to use. Each matte canvas comes with back hanging already included for convenient placement. The frame is made with profile radiata pine that is ethically sourced from renewable forests.

.: Materials: cotton and polyester composite (canvas), pine wood (frame)
.: Comes in 60 different sizes (including vertical and horizontal orientations)
.: Horizontal, vertical and square options available
.: Soft rubber dots on bottom back corners for support
.: Back hanging included
.: Inner frame made with radiata pine sourced from renewable forests
.: Please note: Due to the production process of the canvases, please allow for slight size deviations with a tolerance +/- 1/8" (3.2mm)

lion-of-judah.title: Lion Of Judah
lion-of-judah.description:
Behold the "blue and white intensity" a captivating canvas print that beckons you into the mesmerizing world of the wild. This extraordinary artwork features a striking lion's face set against a deep black background. What makes this piece truly exceptional is the way the lion's visage is divided in half, with one side bathed in regal blue tones and the other side in serene white.

The mane, a work of art in itself, is rendered through skillful splashes of vibrant color, adding an extra layer of dynamism to the composition. The lion's piercing gaze draws you in and evokes a sense of awe and majesty.

"blue and white intensity," isn't just a painting; it's an homage to the magnificence of the animal kingdom and the power of nature's beauty. Hang it in your space, and let it remind you of the strength and grace of these regal creatures. This piece is perfect for those who appreciate the untamed spirit of the wild.

abstract-women-wall-art-print-on-canvas-.title: Intriguing beauty
abstract-women-wall-art-print-on-canvas-.description:
"Intriguing Beauty" is a canvas print that captivates with its allure. The painting features an intriguing and attractive woman whose body is adorned with a burst of vibrant colors, creating a striking contrast against the deep black background of the canvas.

This artwork is a celebration of beauty, mystery, and individuality. The way the colors and the background interact is both captivating and intriguing, making it an attention-grabbing piece.

"Intriguing Beauty" is perfect for those who appreciate the allure of artistic expression and the intrigue of the human form. Display it in your space to infuse it with a sense of intrigue and captivating beauty.

copy-2-framed-butterfly-art-print-demo-p.title: (Copy-2): Framed Butterfly Art Print- Demo Product
copy-2-framed-butterfly-art-print-demo-p.description:
Elevate your space with this stunning Matte Canvas Framed print. Featuring vibrant colors and intricate designs, this artwork brings a touch of modern art to any room. The lively imagery of butterflies exudes a transformative vibe, making it perfect for uplifting your home or office environment. Ideal for art enthusiasts and anyone looking to enhance their décor, this piece resonates beautifully in living rooms, bedrooms, or creative workspaces. It's a thoughtful gift for birthdays, housewarmings, or any celebration where inspiration is needed. Celebrate creativity and nature with this exquisite addition to your collection.

Product features
- High-quality images using UL-certified Greenguard Gold inks for vibrant visuals.

original-artwork-light-of-hope.title: ORIGINAL ARTWORK - light of hope
original-artwork-light-of-hope.description:
Step into the realm of enchantment with my latest creation - an original painting featuring a magnificent blue owl in full flight, wings gracefully spread wide, adorned with captivating splashes of color. This painting isn't just powerful; it's a special masterpiece that brings incredible energies into any home.

Picture this captivating scene - the majestic owl, a symbol of wisdom and mystery, takes flight with wings that stretch across the canvas. The bursts of color add an extra layer of vibrancy, turning this artwork into a visual symphony.

More than a mere painting, this piece is a powerhouse of positive energy. Let the majestic presence of the blue owl fill your space with a sense of wonder and tranquility. It's not just art; it's an invitation to embrace the extraordinary in your everyday surroundings. Elevate your space with this powerful and special addition, and let its energies transform your home.

My original work of art, an original work is unique, yours, and only yours; there are no more!

The white canvas comes to me in the studio and on it I throw all the feelings, emotions and what is going on deep inside me.

Enjoy a piece that is part of my heart.

This canvas is shipped rolled and UNSTRETCHED.

You will need to have it stretched at a framer in your area before it will be ready to hang.

*SIGNATURE:
On the front side

The painting comes with a certificate of originality signed by Albert Levi .

 Dimensions:

150/100 centimeters . 
60/40 inches .

Shipping :Estimated shipping time 14-21 business days, depends on the location.

 

Please contact us if you have any problems with your order 

Please add your cell phone number for safe delivery

Thank you for your visiting and enjoy shopping.

Have a nice day (:

flexi-cases-10.title: Phone Case - Flowers In The Hair
flexi-cases-10.description:
Welcome to a world where my passion for art comes to life on the canvas of your phone. I've poured my heart into creating a collection of phone covers that goes beyond mere accessories – they are a celebration of individuality.

🎨 Authentic Artistry: Each phone cover is a personal expression, a reflection of my genuine emotions and thoughts. From bold strokes to intricate details, these designs are more than visual statements; they're an embodiment of authenticity.

✨ Transformative Experience: Immerse yourself in the world of creativity wherever you go. My designs aren't just about aesthetics; they carry a profound sense of inspiration and joy. Every time you glance at your phone, experience the transformative energy of art.

🤳 Style Meets Protection: More than just visually striking, these covers are crafted with high-quality materials to provide reliable protection for your device. Safeguard your phone from everyday wear and tear while making a stylish impression with these eye-catching designs.

🌟 Join the Movement: By choosing my phone covers, you become part of a movement to spread positivity and creativity. Your phone becomes a canvas for inspiration, radiating light and joy to those around you.

🌍 Inclusivity in Design: My collection embraces diverse tastes, offering designs ranging from bold and vibrant to subtle and elegant. Because art knows no boundaries, my covers cater to a wide range of preferences, ensuring there's an Albert creation for everyone.

🛒 Shop Your Expression: Elevate your phone aesthetics by exploring my online store. Find the perfect phone cover that resonates with your style and spirit. Experience the fusion of art and technology, making your phone a canvas for self-expression.

🎁 Thoughtful Gifts: Looking for a unique gift? Surprise your loved ones with a phone cover that aligns with their personality. Whether it's a birthday, holiday, or just because, my covers make for thoughtful and delightful presents.

🌟 Your Phone, Your Art. Explore Now!
